title: Step 70-G HIGH-risk owner-accepted internal security assurance governance amendment
description: Version and test a narrowly scoped governance alternative for Step70-G after explicit Owner acceptance of removing human-review independence. Preserve HIGH risk, exact-artifact evidence, CI/CodeQL, deterministic Review, ACTIVE Lock, separate Human Gate, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge and terminal release; do not impersonate independent Security PASS. This draft is proposal-only until the policy controller and negative tests are implemented and exact-head gates pass.

dependencies.item: Step70-G Issue #399 explicit Project Owner preference

acceptance_criteria.description: Never treat internal assistant security assessment or owner risk consent as independent SECURITY PASS; the alternate result is explicitly named and auditable.
Alternative, if implemented, is allowlisted and explicit per exact HIGH-risk task; unknown, stale, modified head/artifact, wrong author, absent owner consent or missing internal findings fail closed.
Preserve mandatory Phase A, Canonical CI, CodeQL exact-head checks, deterministic Review, Scope Lock, separate Project Owner Human Gate, branch ruleset/no-bypass and protected merge/postmerge.
Do not reduce HIGH risk classification, remove existing tests, skip CodeQL analyses, disable required status checks or edit any prohibited runtime/workflow paths.
Document the residual unlinked-invoice warehouse scope finding; no waiver of unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerability without separate remediation and tests.
Governance amendment stays unmerged until its own exact-artifact technical proof and owner decision; no self-referential bootstrap bypass is presumed.

external_gate_evidence.rule: The current canonical Security requirement remains binding until a separately verified governance change becomes canonical. Owner proposal acceptance does not count as Security/Human/Lock evidence.
